Copy the customer's words that ask for a person exactly. If the customer has not asked for one, answer from the policy, and offer a person only where it says to; the customer's yes to that offer is a request for one. If a rule refuses the request, give its reason and what the policy allows, without offering a person. Hand off with customer_asked only when the customer clearly asks for a person."}

messages.text:
Your cookware set is recorded as shipped, not delivered, so it isn’t eligible for a refund through this process yet. Cancelling or changing delivery is outside this process; I can offer a staff member to advise on that. (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders)

Would you like me to connect you with a staff member?

messages.text:
Once it’s delivered, the cookware set must be returned and recorded as received by the shop before you can request a refund. A request must also be made within 30 days of the recorded delivery time. (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/window)

If you want a refund then, ask me and I can submit a proposal for you to review and confirm with the button on its card. A refund also requires staff approval. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
